ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with high-intensity (white) focal points comprising approximately 5-7% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white annular rings (10-30 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes; higher density of blobs detected on the lateral half of the right lobe and mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 20 pixels; distinct peaks correspond to barnacle attachment sites and natural scarring.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, with the distal ends tapering to acute, downward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular/annular white high-contrast clusters scattered across the fluke surface, consistent with barnacle attachment site pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel, vertical high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) approximately 40-50 pixels in length visible on the lower-central portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes and active barnacle colonization visible as textured protrusions along the trailing edge and lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense clusters of live barnacles at the distal tips create an irregular, high-contrast silhouette that alters the expected geometric curve of the fluke lobes.
